start.name: Me
start.text: *Cherry blossom petals drift on the spring breeze and settle onto my uniform. New school... well, adapting is kind of my specialty no matter where I end up.*

start_2.name: Me
start_2.text: *Standing at the front gate, unfamiliar buildings stretch out in every direction. Bigger than I expected. The kind of layout that's perfect for getting hopelessly lost.*

start_3.name: Me
start_3.text: *First things first, find the teachers' office. But seriously, does this school not have a single map anywhere?*

name_input_scene.name: System
name_input_scene.text: Transfer student, what is your name?

start_4.text: "Hey, hold up. You're the transfer student they said was coming today, right?"

intro_1.name: Me
intro_1.text: *A girl approaches with an unhurried stride. Crisp uniform, student council armband. Sharp eyes, but there's a subtle ease playing at the corner of her lips.*

intro_2.name: Me
intro_2.text: *I figured she'd be your typical model student, but there's something about those eyes — like she can read you in a single glance. ...This might actually be an interesting school.*

intro_3.name: Seoyeon
intro_3.text: "Student council president, Seoyeon. Our homeroom teacher sent me out here in case you got lost. But you don't look as clueless as I expected?"
choices: Thanks for worrying about me. I really almost got lost. Looking forward to working with you.
The student council president herself? This school's VIP treatment is pretty nice.
Or maybe you came out first because you were curious about me?
*Instead of answering, I just smile lazily and stare right at her.*
Skip the pleasantries. Where's the teachers' office?

path_rude_1.name: Seoyeon
path_rude_1.text: *The warmth in Seoyeon's eyes vanishes for a split second. But she doesn't flinch.*

path_rude_1_2.name: Seoyeon
path_rude_1_2.text: "Wow, your personality isn't just cool — it's arid. Fine by me. I'm not big on forced small talk either. Follow me."

path_friendly_1.name: Seoyeon
path_friendly_1.text: *Seoyeon lets out a small laugh and nods.*

path_friendly_1_2.name: Seoyeon
path_friendly_1_2.text: "Honest type, huh. I like that. I'll personally escort you to the teachers' office, so keep up."

path_tease_1.name: Seoyeon
path_tease_1.text: *I expected her to get flustered, but instead she steps closer and locks eyes with me. The corner of her mouth curls up.*

path_tease_1_2.name: Seoyeon
path_tease_1_2.text: "Confident type, I see? Good — I was getting bored anyway. You're the first person at this school to talk back to me. Interest +1."

path_blush_1.name: Seoyeon
path_blush_1.text: *Seoyeon folds her arms and smiles at a leisurely pace.*

path_blush_1_2.name: Seoyeon
path_blush_1_2.text: "VIP treatment for the transfer student is a one-day-only deal. Enjoy it while it lasts. Now let's move."

path_silent_1.name: Seoyeon
path_silent_1.text: *Seoyeon meets my gaze head-on without looking away. A moment of silence passes, but she doesn't seem the least bit uncomfortable.*

path_silent_1_2.name: Seoyeon
path_silent_1_2.text: "What, the type who lets their eyes do the talking? Not bad. But if we keep standing here, we're both going to be late."

hallway_1.name: Me
hallway_1.text: *I follow Seoyeon down the hallway. The morning commotion of students drifts in through the windows.*

hallway_name_ask.name: Seoyeon
hallway_name_ask.text: *Seoyeon stops walking and turns around.* "Oh, right. I actually saw your name on the office documents beforehand. {name}, right?"

hallway_name_share.name: Me
hallway_name_share.text: "That's right. I'm {name}. You even looked up my name in advance? That's a pretty thorough student council president."

hallway_name_share_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_name_share_2.text: "Obviously. Preparation is the bare minimum. {name}... yeah, the name passes. Let's get along from here."

hallway_1_2.name: Me
hallway_1_2.text: *I walk down the hallway, watching her from behind. She's surprisingly fast.*

hallway_free_talk.name: Seoyeon
hallway_free_talk.text: "Come to think of it, we did introductions but haven't had an actual conversation. Ask me whatever you want. Whether I answer depends on my mood, though."
hallway_free_talk.context: Walking through the school hallway together with the transfer student protagonist, having a casual conversation. Seoyeon keeps a cool, composed attitude but is quietly enjoying the exchange. Keep the conversation going until it naturally wraps up. Once it ends, the scene transitions to Seoyeon giving a tour of the school facilities. Only in the final turn should she suggest they start moving or begin the tour.
hallway_free_talk.personality: Cool-beauty student council president. Delivers blunt observations and dry humor, parrying the protagonist's provocations with effortless composure. Prefers natural back-and-forth banter over fake politeness.

hallway_1_3_high.name: Me
hallway_1_3_high.text: *Chatting with Seoyeon somehow turned into a school tour. Our conversational rhythm just clicks.*
choices: Nice facilities. Are you in any clubs, Seoyeon?
The facilities are great, but honestly they look even better with this tour guide.
Seoyeon, you've got a great voice. You could do campus tours professionally.
*I pretend to listen to her explanation while sneaking glances at her profile.*

hallway_1_3_low.name: Me
hallway_1_3_low.text: *Seoyeon's attitude has gotten noticeably colder. I must have rubbed her the wrong way during our conversation. She's switched to a strictly business tone for the tour.*
choices: Nice facilities. Are you in any clubs, Seoyeon?
The facilities are great, but they look even better with a good tour guide.
Seoyeon, honestly your voice is the best feature this school has.
*I just walk quietly and focus on her explanation.*

hallway_1_3.name: Me
hallway_1_3.text: *Following Seoyeon's tour down the hallway. Her explanations are clean and to the point — easy to listen to.*
choices: Nice facilities. Are you in any clubs, Seoyeon?
The facilities are great, but they look even better with a good tour guide.
Seoyeon, honestly your voice is the best feature this school has.
*I just walk quietly and focus on her explanation.*

hallway_talk_trap_high.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_high.text: *Seoyeon's eyes go wide, then she can't hold back a laugh — her shoulders shake. The tips of her ears going pink is definitely not my imagination.*

hallway_talk_trap_high_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_high_2.text: "Wow, you're really something on day one. But here's the thing — lines like that lose their value if you use them twice. Save them."

hallway_talk_trap_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_low.text: *Seoyeon's gaze goes ice-cold in an instant. She even stops walking and faces me head-on.*

hallway_talk_trap_low_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_low_2.text: "...I get that it's a compliment, but we haven't even known each other for thirty minutes. Keep that kind of distance, please."

hallway_talk_trap_normal.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_normal.text: *Seoyeon pauses and stares at me. Her expression is half guarded, half surprised.*

hallway_talk_trap_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_trap_normal_2.text: "I appreciate it, but... we're not exactly close enough for that yet, are we? Ease up on the pace a little."

hallway_talk_club_high.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_high.text: *Something sparks in her eyes. There's a hint of anticipation on her face.*

hallway_talk_club_high_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_high_2.text: "Student council and the gardening club. I like growing flowers — surprising, right? I'll show you the greenhouse sometime. Exclusive {name}-only tour, just for you."

hallway_talk_club_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_low.text: *She answers in a flat, businesslike tone. Barely any feeling behind it.*

hallway_talk_club_low_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_low_2.text: "Student council and gardening club. That's it. Next question?"

hallway_talk_club_normal.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_normal.text: *She raises an eyebrow, looking mildly surprised.*

hallway_talk_club_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_club_normal_2.text: "Yeah, student council and gardening club. I like growing flowers. Getting my hands in the dirt clears my head. Drop by the greenhouse sometime if you're interested."

hallway_talk_flatter_high.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_high.text: *The tips of Seoyeon's ears turn pink. She tucks her hair behind her ear and looks away, but her lips clearly aren't cooperating with the rest of her poker face.*

hallway_talk_flatter_high_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_high_2.text: "...Okay, you're unexpectedly smooth. Nobody's said something like that to me as a transfer student before. Fine, I admit it — giving this tour is actually a little rewarding."

hallway_talk_flatter_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_low.text: *She practically scoffs, looking me up and down. Her expression is openly unimpressed.*

hallway_talk_flatter_low_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_low_2.text: "You already used up your smooth-talk quota on the first impression. Try something that actually sounds genuine next time. Let's keep moving."

hallway_talk_flatter_normal.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_normal.text: *She turns her head away for a moment, caught off guard, but quickly recovers her composure.*

hallway_talk_flatter_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_flatter_normal_2.text: "Weirdly enough, it's kind of easy being around you. It's been a while since someone talked to me without the 'student council president' filter. ...Not a bad feeling, I guess."

hallway_talk_listen_high.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_high.text: *She picks up speed with her explanations, getting into it. Every time I nod along, her expression brightens a little more.*

hallway_talk_listen_high_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_high_2.text: "Oh, you're actually paying attention. Most people zone out or start fidgeting by now. {name}, you're surprisingly diligent. I approve."

hallway_talk_listen_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_low.text: *She continues explaining mechanically as she walks. She doesn't even glance my way.*

hallway_talk_listen_low_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_low_2.text: "If you got all that, let's go. Time's wasting."

hallway_talk_listen_normal.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_normal.text: *She's getting into her explanation, adding hand gestures and everything.*

hallway_talk_listen_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_talk_listen_normal_2.text: "It's rare to find someone who actually listens all the way through. {name}, you might be alright. With that attitude, you'll settle in fast."

hallway_2_normal.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_normal.text: *Seoyeon suddenly stops and turns to look at me. There's a probing look in her eyes, like she's sizing me up.*

hallway_2_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_low.text: *Seoyeon, walking ahead, suddenly stops. She looks back at me over her shoulder with cold eyes.*

hallway_2_2_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_2_low.text: *There's an unmistakable distance in the way she looks at me.*

hallway_2_3_low.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_3_low.text: "A word of advice. If you keep this up from day one, things are going to be rough for you here. At least respect the basics."

hallway_2_2.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_2.text: *She stares into my eyes like she's trying to read something. An appraising look.*

hallway_2_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_2_3.text: "Thought about clubs at all? Student council is always short-handed. If you joined... I could personally train you."
choices: If I join student council, I'd get to see you every day? Sign me up right now.
More than clubs... I want to know more about you, Seoyeon.
Not sure yet. I'll look around and decide.
Pass. Clubs aren't my thing.

path_rude_2.name: Seoyeon
path_rude_2.text: *The anticipation drains from Seoyeon's expression. She tries not to let it show.*

path_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
path_flirt_2.text: *Seoyeon's face flushes slightly. She fiddles with her uniform, trying to mask being caught off guard.*

path_flirt_2_2.name: Seoyeon
path_flirt_2_2.text: "Every day... do you have any idea how much work is involved? Still, if you joined, I guess it wouldn't be boring. I'll hold you to that."

path_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
path_normal_2.text: *She nods and starts walking ahead again. She says "Smart choice," but there's a trace of disappointment in her voice.*

path_direct_2.name: Seoyeon
path_direct_2.text: *Seoyeon's eyes go wide, then she lets out a disbelieving laugh. She laughs for a good while.*

path_direct_2_2.name: Seoyeon
path_direct_2_2.text: "Wow, straight fastball. About me, huh... well, that depends on how you play it from here. I don't give that up easily."

classroom_1_1_high.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_1_high.text: *At the classroom door, Seoyeon casually takes my hand. Warm and soft.*

classroom_1_2_high.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_2_high.text: *Seoyeon leans in and whispers near my ear.* "Don't be nervous. We're in the same class anyway, so whatever happens, I've got your back."

classroom_1_3_high.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_3_high.text: "This is our class. Oh, and the seat next to mine happens to be open. Lucky you, transfer student."

classroom_1_1_low.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_1_low.text: *At the classroom door. Seoyeon walks ahead, putting physical distance between us.*

classroom_1_2_low.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_2_low.text: *She silently jerks her chin toward the sign next to the door. She doesn't even make eye contact.*

classroom_1_3_low.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_3_low.text: "Class 2-3. The teacher's inside, so go on in. Making a bad impression by being late on your first day wouldn't be great."

classroom_1_1.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_1.text: *We've arrived at the classroom door. Chatter drifts out from inside. Seoyeon gives my shoulder a light tap.*

classroom_1_2.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_2.text: *She flashes me a quick thumbs up. It's an unexpectedly casual gesture, and some of my tension melts away.*

classroom_1_3.name: Seoyeon
classroom_1_3.text: "This is Class 2-3. Don't overthink it. I'm right here, so just be yourself."

classroom_2_normal.name: Me
classroom_2_normal.text: *Standing at the podium, dozens of eyes lock onto me all at once. Curiosity, wariness, indifference... a whole spectrum. Seoyeon is leaning back in her seat with her arms crossed, watching me at her own pace.*

classroom_2_high.name: Me
classroom_2_high.text: *Standing at the podium, dozens of eyes lock onto me. Seoyeon is smiling at me from her seat. It's oddly reassuring.*

classroom_2_low.name: Me
classroom_2_low.text: *Standing at the podium, dozens of eyes lock onto me. Seoyeon is staring out the window, looking thoroughly uninterested.*

classroom_2_2.name: Teacher
classroom_2_2.text: *The homeroom teacher raps the podium a couple times to settle the room. Stern expression, but the corner of her mouth is slightly lifted.*

teacher_free_talk.name: Teacher
teacher_free_talk.text: "Alright, I know everyone's curious about the transfer student, but staring alone won't make you friends. Before the introduction, if you have any questions for me, go ahead and ask. No pressure."
teacher_free_talk.context: Location: In front of the podium in Class 2-3. Situation: A brief moment before the homeroom teacher formally introduces the transfer student protagonist to the class. Dozens of students are watching, but this conversation is strictly between the protagonist and the teacher. The protagonist's formal introduction and greeting to the class is a separate event that happens AFTER this dialogue — do NOT have the protagonist greet or introduce themselves to the students during this exchange. Keep to personal questions, school life tips, first impressions, etc. Continue the conversation until it wraps up naturally. Only in the final turn should the teacher mention they'll now formally introduce the protagonist to the class.
teacher_free_talk.personality: Dry humor with an unexpected soft side. Looks strict but is warm underneath, and is quietly curious about the transfer student. Occasionally shows an endearingly clumsy gap — the kind of teacher who says 'you shouldn't say that' and then adds 'honestly, same though.'

classroom_2_3_high.name: Me
classroom_2_3_high.text: *Chatting with the teacher loosened me up. She's more fun than I expected. Now it's time to introduce myself to the class.*
choices: I'm '{name}'. Nice to meet everyone.
Starting today, I'm in this class! Let's have a good time.
Hey! I'm the type who likes to stay active!
Nice to meet you. I'm more of a quiet, keep-to-myself type.
I'm here to study. Just don't get in my way and we'll be fine.

classroom_2_3_low.name: Me
classroom_2_3_low.text: *The teacher's gaze is pretty sharp. Feels like I already lost some first-impression points. Either way, the intro has to happen.*
choices: I'm '{name}'. Nice to meet everyone.
Starting today, I'm in this class! Let's have a good time.
Hey! I'm the type who likes to stay active!
Nice to meet you. I'm more of a quiet, keep-to-myself type.
I'm here to study. Just don't get in my way and we'll be fine.

classroom_2_3.name: Me
classroom_2_3.text: *The conversation with the teacher ends, and I face the class. Dozens of pairs of eyes are pointed at me.*
choices: I'm '{name}'. Nice to meet everyone.
Starting today, I'm in this class! Let's have a good time.
Hey! I'm the type who likes to stay active!
Nice to meet you. I'm more of a quiet, keep-to-myself type.
I'm here to study. Just don't get in my way and we'll be fine.

teacher_name_share_high.name: Teacher
teacher_name_share_high.text: "(Looking pleased) {name}... nice name. Go ahead, say a few words to the class. Everyone, make them feel welcome."

teacher_name_share_low.name: Teacher
teacher_name_share_low.text: "...{name}. Keep your introduction short and take your seat."

teacher_name_share_normal.name: Teacher
teacher_name_share_normal.text: "{name}. Alright, go ahead and say hi to the class."

class_after_name.name: Teacher
class_after_name.text: "{name}... nice name. Alright everyone, give them a warm welcome."

class_after_active.name: Classmates
class_after_active.text: *Cheers erupt from around the classroom. The guys in the back rows are already eyeing me with interest. Seoyeon watches from her seat with her arms crossed, looking quietly satisfied.*

class_after_active_2.name: Classmates
class_after_active_2.text: *I can already hear whispered negotiations about recruiting me for teams.*

class_after_active_3.name: Classmates
class_after_active_3.text: "Oh nice, looks like you've got some game! How about a round at the gym during lunch? Show us what the new kid can do!"

class_after_quiet.name: Classmates
class_after_quiet.text: *The students nod and accept me with calm composure. A few girls whisper among themselves, glancing my way.*

class_after_quiet_2.name: Classmates
class_after_quiet_2.text: *Seoyeon nods with a satisfied expression. The classroom settles into a calm atmosphere.*

class_after_quiet_3.name: Classmates
class_after_quiet_3.text: "Kind of has a vibe... mind if we chat sometime?"

class_after_party.name: Classmates
class_after_party.text: *The classroom erupts into chaos. Students swarm in from every direction.*

class_after_party_2.name: Classmates
class_after_party_2.text: *Seoyeon looks momentarily caught off guard but breaks into a grin. The students have already moved on to debating lunch options.*

class_after_party_3.name: Classmates
class_after_party_3.text: "Oh man, absolute legend energy! {name}, eat lunch with us! We know all the best spots!"

class_after_study.name: Classmates
class_after_study.text: *A brief silence falls over the classroom. The students shift uncomfortably, exchanging glances.*

class_after_study_2.name: Classmates
class_after_study_2.text: *Seoyeon's expression tightens subtly too. An invisible wall has gone up.*

class_after_study_3.name: Classmates
class_after_study_3.text: "Whoa... total do-not-disturb energy. Probably best not to poke that one..."
